scope: Phase 3 Controlled Physics-Informed Multi-Task Loss Training Experiment

incompatible_dvorak_pairs_evaluated.meteorological_rationale: An eye requires a closed central core convective wall and sustained winds >= 89 km/h (T >= 3.5), which cannot physically exist at Cyclonic Storm stage.
An eye is physically impossible in a deep depression (wind 50-61 km/h).
An eye is physically impossible in a weak depression (wind 31-49 km/h).
A strongly sheared pattern with exposed low-level circulation center cannot maintain central core intensity > 166 km/h.

differentiable_physics_loss_definition: L_phys = mean_b [ sum_{(i, j) in Incompatible} P(pattern=i | x_b) * P(category=j | x_b) ]
multi_task_total_loss: L_total = L_presence + L_pattern + L_category + lambda_phys * L_phys
